newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss launch three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss launch three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government is launching three-month money market claims in a new series 3.369 to be paid for on January 16, the Swiss National Bank said.

The allocation follows the end of subscriptions on January 14. The previous issue of three-month claims series 3.368, paid for on January 9, raised 831.5 million francs and was priced at 99.591 percent to yield 1.625 percent annually.
